title: OpenTide deployment state shard
description: Vendor-assigned rule ids for one rule, per state-backed platform and tenant, stored at .opentide/states/deployment/<uuid>.json (specs/deployment-state.md). The filename stem must equal object_uuid; JSON Schema cannot see the filename, so readers check that separately. Readers may accept empty platform maps; writers never emit them.

object_uuid.description: metadata.uuid of the rule, lowercase canonical.

tenantName.description: Configured tenant name with surrounding whitespace removed: non-empty, no leading or trailing whitespace.

decimalTenants.description: Tenant name to canonical decimal integer id (no sign, no leading zero), as a string.

verbatimTenants.description: Tenant name to the create-response id, verbatim, as a string with at least one non-whitespace character.
